verdict.rationale: Yapily publishes a first-party, per-endpoint API reference (e.g. get-accounts, get-account-transactions, authorisation endpoints, authentication). Nothing in the evidence shows that this reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI spec is meant for client-library generation, the sandbox is a separate test environment rather than in-docs execution, and probes for a hosted openapi.json all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request execution in the reference, code samples per endpoint, a publicly reachable spec powering the reference, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
